## NVENCForge 2.2.2: built on GitHub, ready for code signing

Converting works exactly as in 2.2.1. This release is about where the exe comes from.

- **Built by GitHub Actions** from the source in this repository, never on a private PC. Releases can now also be started by hand on GitHub, and a dry run checks the whole build without publishing anything.
- **File properties:** `NVENCForge.exe` now shows its name and version under right-click > Properties > Details.
- **Code signing prepared:** free code signing through the SignPath Foundation is applied for. Until it is active the exe stays unsigned. What would be signed, who approves it and what NVENCForge sends over the network (only the FFmpeg download): [code signing policy](https://github.com/burnersen/NVENCForge/blob/main/CODE_SIGNING.md).
- **License:** GPL-3.0-only, and nothing else.

Update: replace `NVENCForge.exe` with the new one. Your settings stay. With NVENCForgeGUI: use the converter's update button.
